# Paper and Stitch

> A lifestyle blog featuring DIY home projects, craft tutorials, furniture makeovers, and creative recipes by Brittni Mehlhoff.

Paper and Stitch is a creative lifestyle blog that combines home organization and decor projects with sewing tutorials, upcycling crafts, and food photography. The site features a mix of DIY projects ranging from beginner-friendly sewing to woodworking, alongside behind-the-scenes studio life content and guest posts from other creators.

## Key Topics

- DIY projects
- Home organization
- Furniture makeover
- Sewing tutorials
- Upcycling
- Budget-friendly crafts
- Home decor
- Beginner sewing
- Craft tutorials
- Before and after
- Studio life
- Guest posts
- Lifestyle blog
- Brittni Mehlhoff
- Paper and Stitch Blog

## Home Organization & Storage

- [DIY Modern Seating and Storage with Maple Plywood](https://www.papernstitchblog.com/how-to-create-modern-custom-seating-storage-built-ins): Weekend DIY project: Build custom seating and storage with maple plywood
- [A Modern DIY Bathroom Organizer (with Mirror)](https://www.papernstitchblog.com/diy-bathroom-organizer): Modern DIY bathroom organizer project using scrap plywood and leather
- [Woven Loop Baskets for Organization and Storage](https://www.papernstitchblog.com/diy-basket-storage): DIY woven loop basket tutorial for budget-friendly storage and organization
- [Organize Your Life: Bulletin Board Tutorial](https://www.papernstitchblog.com/vintage-bulletin-board-tutorial): DIY vintage bulletin board craft using recycled materials and cork

## Sewing & Fabric Crafts

- [How to Make Reusable Produce Bags in 15 Minutes](https://www.papernstitchblog.com/reusable-produce-bags): Quick sewing tutorial for eco-friendly reusable produce bags using muslin
- [Over the Moon: How to Make Star and Moon Ornaments for the Holidays](https://www.papernstitchblog.com/how-to-make-fabric-ornaments): DIY sewing tutorial for handmade star and moon fabric holiday ornaments

## Furniture Makeovers & Before & After

- [Before + After: Becky's Romantic Wardrobe DIY Makeover](https://www.papernstitchblog.com/before-after-beckys-romantic-wardrobe-diy-makeover): Guest post: Romantic furniture restoration and DIY wardrobe makeover project
